title: Max Earns a Bulldog Buck
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: At McKinley, you can earn a Bulldog Buck when you make a great choice. Max really, really wants one.
On Monday, Max tries to be extra good. Max sits up so straight that Max almost falls off the chair. No Bulldog Buck.
On Tuesday, Max raises a paw to answer every question, even the ones Max does not know. No Bulldog Buck.
On Wednesday, Max forgets all about Bulldog Bucks. At lunch in the MPR, Max sees a new kid sitting alone. Max walks over and says, "Do you want to sit with us?"
After lunch, the teacher hands Max a blue paper Bulldog Buck. "That was kind and caring," she says. "That is what a Bulldog does."
Max learns something. Bulldog Bucks are not about showing off. They are about being safe, responsible, and kind.
On the first Friday of the month, Max's class visits the Bulldog Bodega. It is a cart in the Staff Lounge, full of fun things to buy with Bulldog Bucks.
There are pencils, stickers, erasers shaped like food, and fidget toys. Max picks a squishy fidget shaped like a little turtle.
Back in class, Max squeezes the turtle during reading time. It helps Max focus. And every time Max squeezes it, Max remembers the new friend at lunch.

quiz.q: What did Max buy at the Bulldog Bodega?
quiz.ev: Max picks a squishy fidget shaped like a little turtle.

quiz.q: Why did Max finally get a Bulldog Buck?
o: Max was kind to a new kid
quiz.ev: "That was kind and caring," she says.

o: Doing what you should, even when no one is watching
quiz.ev: They are about being safe, responsible, and kind.
